instructions: Zasder Weather's self-hosted backend (FastAPI + aiosqlite) with its LilyGO firmware and WeatherLink Live poller. This repository is generated from a private monorepo; review the code, but fixes land upstream. Report substantive defects, not style preferences.

rules.rule: FastAPI + aiosqlite backend, self-hosted by third parties from this public repo — assume the reader is deploying it, not just reading it. Prioritise: (1) SQL correctness, especially f-string interpolation into SQL — flag any value that is NOT from an internal whitelist; (2) timezone / local period-boundary handling in rain rollups and records; (3) async issues — blocking calls on the event loop, fire-and-forget tasks whose exceptions vanish, unbounded caches; (4) secrets reaching logs (credentials are passed as query params to some upstream APIs, and exception messages can embed the full URL); (5) auth gaps on new endpoints — note that /, /healthz, /status, /api/version and /metrics are intentionally open, as is, since 2.1, the OAuth surface for the MCP server (the two /.well-known/oauth-* documents, POST /oauth/register, GET+POST /oauth/authorize, POST /oauth/token, POST /oauth/revoke: open per the MCP authorization spec, rate-limited, granting nothing without a connect code minted in the app, or the API token, on the consent page); POST /mcp takes the bearer or an OAuth access token; every other /api/* route is token-gated, and /ingest/custom is gated by a separate INGEST_TOKEN.
Units are stored API-native (degrees F, mph, inHg, inches) and converted only for display. Flag any threshold or constant compared against a display-unit value.
A missing reading is not zero. Flag `or 0` and similar defaults that turn an absent sensor value into a real-looking 0.

pytest with asyncio_mode=auto. Flag tests that mutate shared state (env vars, the on-disk SQLite file, module-level singletons) without restoring it, and any test that would still pass if the behaviour it names regressed.

Pure-stdlib Python service polling a Davis WeatherLink Live gateway on the LAN and forwarding to /ingest/custom. It must stay dependency-free — flag any new third-party import. Prioritise unit conversions, resilience to malformed/partial gateway JSON, and retry/backoff behaviour when the gateway or backend is unreachable.
ESP32 (Arduino) firmware for SDR weather-sensor capture. Prioritise memory safety, blocking work in loop(), watchdog interaction, and the provisioning/auth surface on its local HTTP server.

Setup and operations scripts that self-hosters run on their own machines, often by copy-paste and sometimes as root. Prioritise: unquoted expansions, missing `set -euo pipefail`, destructive commands (rm -rf, docker volume prune) whose target could be empty or unset, and any command that would echo a token to the terminal or into a world-readable file.
